Wait a second, that seems straightforward. But I'm wondering if there was any mistake in the calculations. Let me double-check the math. 4 visits at $45 each would indeed be 4*45 = $180. Then subtracting the season pass of $99, so 180 - 99 = 81. That seems correct.
